message.content: {"reason": "Trusted validation is plateaued at 0.7286 with the DCN-MoE NN, and historical runs show the dominant signal is axis-aligned high-order categorical interaction that the soft cross-layer cannot capture; prior NN+GBDT blends either regressed or broke on dual-learner bookkeeping, while target-encoding fixes historically helped when integer codes were replaced by smoothed acceptance statistics. The initial plan's Tier 3 shift — make a single HistGradientBoostingClassifier the whole pipeline and feed it leakage-safe target-encoded categorical crosses — directly attacks the representational plateau with a mechanically lower-variance design. These three modules are the right places because the change requires coordinated edits to feature engineering (TE encoders), model design (HGB factory and persistence), and training/evaluation (fold-local TE wiring, threshold tuning, bundle reload).", "module": ["data_processing_and_feature_engineering", "model_design", "training_evaluation"], "plan": {"data_processing_and_feature_engineering": "WHAT: Extend CouponFeatureEngineer with a smoothed target encoder for the schema categoricals (coupon, occupation, education, income, age, maritalStatus, gender, time, expiration) and for key high-order crosses (coupon|occupation, coupon|time|direction_opp, coupon|income, coupon_venue_affinity_bucket|coupon), producing encoded = (sum_y + prior*m)/(count + m) with m=20 and storing maps, prior, m, te_col_names on the engineer. WHY: historical failures trace to feeding arbitrary integer codes to the GBDT, which imposes false ordering on nominals that directly drive acceptance; replacing those codes with shrink-corrected acceptance statistics is the single highest-value feature fix and matches what worked in prior TE experiments. HOW: add fit_target_encoding(df, y, fold_ids, m=20) that builds per-column maps only from each fold's training rows to yield leakage-safe OOF encodings for training rows and fold-val transformed values, plus transform_target_encoding(df) that applies saved maps with unseen/NaN categories falling back to the stored global prior; keep engineer_features, feature_order_, num_cols_, cat_cols_, fill_values_, and CouponFeatureEngineer.fit/transform signatures unchanged, appending the TE block to num_cols_ ordering deterministically so downstream code can reindex safely.", "model_design": "WHAT: Replace CouponDCNMoE + torch state-dict training with sklearn.ensemble.HistGradientBoostingClassifier as the sole learner, constructed via a make_hgb(seed) factory (learning_rate~0.03, max_iter~600, max_leaf_nodes~31, min_samples_leaf~20, l2_regularization~1.0, early_stopping with validation_fraction=0.1, random_state=seed) that operates on the engineered matrix where raw integer categorical columns are swapped for their target-encoded values. WHY: the plateau root cause is a hypothesis-class mismatch — trees natively encode multiplicative coupon×affinity×occupation×time interactions that the soft cross layer only approximates on 8k rows — and prior blend attempts failed on dual-learner bookkeeping, so a single HGB removes the highest-risk code while improving the hypothesis class. HOW: keep the module importable alongside torch (torch stays imported but unused for the new path) and add joblib/pickle-based persistence helpers _save_bundle(path, bundle) and _load_bundle(path) that serialize the fitted engineer (with TE state), indexer, HGB model, threshold, label mapping, and feature metadata as a single joblib file bundle.joblib; preserve the existing run_train/run_predict entry-point signatures and the CouponDCNMoE class definition (kept but unused) so other modules retain import compatibility.", "training_evaluation": "WHAT: Rewrite the CV/refit/predict wiring so each StratifiedKFold(5, shuffle, random_state=42) fold fits CouponFeatureEngineer, the TE maps, and the CategoricalIndexer on TRAIN rows only, trains make_hgb(SEED+fold) on the TE-substituted matrix, and collects OOF probabilities; then tune the decision threshold on OOF accuracy (official metric) over a fine grid (0.20–0.80, step 0.01), refit a final HGB on all training rows with full-data TE maps, and persist everything through the new bundle.joblib. WHY: historical successes required per-fold state fitting and read-only reload to avoid silent leakage and fresh-process failures; a single HGB refit (no seed ensembling) keeps train time well under 600 s and removes blend-weight bug surface. HOW: keep run_train(data_dir, model_dir) and run_predict(data_dir, model_dir, output_path) signatures, preserve _train_loop-like logging where useful but stop calling it for NN training, keep row_id=0..N-1 authoritative order and original-label mapping via stored pos_label/neg_label classes, and ensure run_predict only loads bundle.joblib (never refits engineer, TE, indexer, or HGB) before thresholding predict_proba and writing row_id,prediction."}}

We need to refine the initial plan into structured JSON. The initial plan is Tier 3: single strong GBDT pipeline (HistGradientBoostingClassifier) with leakage-safe target encoding for high-order categorical crosses, replacing the NN. Modules affected: model_design (replace NN with HGB), data_processing_and_feature_engineering (add target encoding), training_evaluation (fold loop, threshold tuning, bundle persistence).

Historical successes: GBDT blend changes, target encoding additions worked (some failed due to leakage or bugs). Failed: blending weak learners, stacking regressions, arbitrary integer codes.

Refine: module array should be all three: data_processing_and_feature_engineering, model_design, training_evaluation. Keep plan detailed with interfaces preserved: CouponFeatureEngineer, engineer_features, _train_loop, run_train, run_predict, bundle keys, etc.

Target encoding: use smoothed TE with m=20, prior, computed only from fold-train rows; OOF encoding for training rows within CV. Also handle unseen categories fallback to prior.

HGB: use HistGradientBoostingClassifier with categorical_features mask over indexer codes, or feed TE + numerics. Persist via joblib/pickle. Keep threshold tuning on OOF accuracy. Keep StratifiedKFold(5, shuffle, random_state=42). Predict path loads encoders + HGB.

Consider time limit 600s per process: HGB is fast, fine.

Also note historical failed experiment with weak target encoding due to arbitrary integer codes — our plan replaces integer codes for GBDT matrix with TE values, which is exactly that fix. Good.
